title: State Compliance Bulletin: Final-Fee Share of the All-Inclusive Utility Package by Community State
content:
# State Final-Fee Share — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Bulletin clause.** The prorated final package fee of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account is the package's monthly fee times the days charged divided by 30 times a state final-fee share set by the community's state as recorded on the Apartment Home Lease — all multiplied together and rounded half up to the cent once:

| State recorded on the lease | State final-fee share |
|---|---|
| AZ | 0.95 |
| TX | 0.95 |
| CA | 0.97 |
| WA | 0.97 |
| CO, GA or any other state | the whole fee (1.0) |

## Worked cases (hypothetical monthly fee of $150.00, 17 days charged)

- TX: $150.00 times 17 divided by 30 times 0.95 is $80.75.
- WA: the same times 0.97 is $82.45.
- GA: the whole fee, $85.00.

For 11 days in CA: $150.00 times 11 divided by 30 times 0.97 is $53.35.
